cases.question: 各大类的销售金额构成是怎样的？哪个大类占比最高？
cases.goldSql: SELECT pc.Name, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS amt FROM salesorderdetail sod JOIN product p ON p.ProductID=sod.ProductID JOIN productsubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID=p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryID=ps.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY pc.Name ORDER BY amt DESC
cases.note: 三层雪花上的构成分析。Bikes 应最高。

cases.question: 销售金额逐年的走势如何？
cases.goldSql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS y, SUM(TotalDue) AS amt FROM salesorderheader GROUP BY y ORDER BY y
cases.note: 时间序列。2001-2004 四年，2003 最高。要求按月/年分组。

cases.question: 线上订单和线下订单的销售金额谁更高？差多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT CASE WHEN OnlineOrderFlag=1 THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS ch, SUM(TotalDue) AS amt FROM salesorderheader GROUP BY ch
cases.note: 两个条件的对比。模型可能用条件指标或分组。

cases.question: 各销售区域的销售金额差距有多大？哪个区域最好？
cases.goldSql: SELECT st.Name, SUM(soh.TotalDue) AS amt FROM salesorderheader soh JOIN customer c ON c.CustomerID=soh.CustomerID JOIN salesterritory st ON st.TerritoryID=c.TerritoryID GROUP BY st.Name ORDER BY amt DESC
cases.note: 两跳 JOIN 上的构成。Southwest 最高。

cases.question: 2004 年销售金额比 2003 年下降了这么多，主要是什么原因造成的？
cases.goldSql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS y, SUM(TotalDue) AS amt FROM salesorderheader WHERE OrderDate >= '2003-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2006-01-01' GROUP BY y
cases.note: 归因题：必须拆成「总量对比」+「按维度拆解」至少两步才有意义。单步答不了 why。

cases.question: 各大类里，线上和线下的销售表现有什么差别？
cases.goldSql: SELECT pc.Name, SUM(CASE WHEN soh.OnlineOrderFlag=1 THEN sod.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS online, SUM(CASE WHEN soh.OnlineOrderFlag=0 THEN sod.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS offline FROM salesorderdetail sod JOIN salesorderheader soh ON soh.SalesOrderID=sod.SalesOrderID JOIN product p ON p.ProductID=sod.ProductID JOIN productsubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID=p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryID=ps.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY pc.Name
cases.note: 两个维度交叉，需要多次取数或条件指标组合。
